scope: PostgreSQL multi-array unnest enum-array resolution, heterogeneous output, order and NULL padding under a shadowed search_path
assertions: Untyped multi-array unnest($1, $2) returns PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 42725; explicit target-schema enum[] and integer[] casts work while a same-named shadow enum leads search_path.
Native arrays and bound parameters agree on output rows, ordinality, enum and integer element types, and storage order.
Cases cover unequal lengths in both directions, SQL NULL arrays, empty arrays, a multidimensional enum array with non-default bounds, and literal NULL/SQL NULL/empty enum labels.
Shorter arrays and SQL NULL enum arrays are padded with SQL NULL rows; multidimensional input is emitted in row-major storage order.
A label defined only by the shadow enum is rejected with PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22P02.
